instructions: Complete the sentences below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
word_limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER

items.prompt: When they list their sources, the students must follow the guide that appears on the (27) ........ .
items.evidence: follow the guide on the module page — not the version in last year's handbook, which is out of date
items.explanation: The adviser says the version in last year's handbook is out of date; the referencing guide should be taken from the module page.

items.prompt: A rehearsal slot in the room where they will speak is arranged through the (28) ........ .
items.evidence: You can book the media suite through the department office
items.explanation: The media suite where the presentation will take place is booked through the department office.

items.prompt: As reservations cannot be made more than seven days ahead, they should book the room on (29) ........ .
items.evidence: The office takes bookings up to a week ahead, so the Friday would be the safe day.
items.explanation: Because the office only takes bookings up to a week in advance, Friday is the safe day.

items.prompt: The tutor warns the group against opening their talk with a (30) ........ .
items.evidence: Don't open with a definition of community energy
items.explanation: The adviser gives two things to avoid; the first is opening with a definition, because everyone in the room has read the same chapter.

yeniden_uretim.uretilen_grup: L1 dinleme - sizinti onarimi (yalniz kok / secenek / cerceve)
yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: The tutor tells them that their opening should not be a (30) ........ of community energy.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Senaryo gösterilmeden 3/3 turda doğru bilindi: 'açılışları topluluk enerjisinin bir (30) olmamalı' çerçevesi sunum öğüdünün kalıp cümlesi ('tanımla açma'), boşluk kendi kalıbının içinde.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Cevap (definition) ve dayanak noktasi ayni; degisen yalnizca cumle cercevesi. Eski cerceve 'topluluk enerjisinin bir (30) olmamali' diyerek boslugu kendi kalibinin icine koyuyordu: 'X'in tanimi' tamlamasi ve 'acilista tanim yapma' ogudu birlikte cevabi sunum kliseleri bilgisiyle veriyordu. Yeni cerceveden hem 'of community energy' tamlamasi hem de kalibi tamamlayan karsitlik cikarildi; bosluga artik joke, apology, quotation, summary gibi adaylar da esit oturuyor, secim konusmadan yapiliyor.
